note: every message or ticket that voices the need counts once; a '+1 same for us' counts; a question about who builds it, greetings and chatter do not.

themes.title: Four-eyes approval for invoices over 10,000 EUR
Dark mode in the customer portal

slack.text: Ann (Sales): We keep missing the notice dates on contracts. Somebody should remind the owner 90 days before a renewal.
Wir verpassen immer wieder Kündigungsfristen. Eine Erinnerung an den Vertragsverantwortlichen wäre Gold wert. (Bernd, Einkauf)

replies.text: +1, same for us in Legal. Today it is a spreadsheet nobody opens.
Who could build that? Is there budget?

slack.text: Carla (Finance): Auto-renewals surprised us again in October. We need an early warning with the contract value.
Dev (IT): Owners of expiring licences are never told. Could the system send a reminder weeks ahead?
Eva (Controlling): Invoices above 10k EUR must be approved by two people, but today it is only a convention. Can the system enforce it?
Für Rechnungen über 10.000 Euro brauchen wir ein Vier-Augen-Prinzip im Freigabeprozess. (Frank, Buchhaltung)
Gina (Support): Customers ask for a dark mode in the portal, three tickets this week.
Thanks everyone, the build is green again.
Reminder: all-hands tomorrow 10:00, link in the invite.
Does anyone know why the printer on floor 3 is offline?

jira.summary: Warn contract owners before a contract renews
jira.description: Contract owners are not told when a notice period ends. We want a reminder 90 days and 30 days before.

jira.summary: Second approver for invoices over 10,000 EUR
jira.description: Invoices above 10,000 EUR need a second approver before they are released for payment.

jira.summary: Enforce four-eyes principle on high-value payments
jira.description: Large payments are released by one person today. Audit asks that a second person confirms them.

jira.summary: Dark theme for the customer portal
jira.description: Customers ask for a dark colour scheme in the portal, mainly for evening use.
